Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Lakshmi Ranade. I am a 73-year-old mechanical engineer living in Madurai. My spouse Vandana Sathe and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of ₹9,45,000, and the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 98323 90037 or email lakshmi.ranade@example.com.
